# Vaz & Associates, Chartered Accountants

> Chartered accountancy practice in Borivali West, Mumbai, India, led by Ryan Vaz, FCA, a Fellow Chartered Accountant and Certified Forensic Accountant (ICAI) with more than 25 years of CFO-level experience in India, Uganda and Tanzania. Clients are served in person in Mumbai's western suburbs and remotely across India and abroad, including non-resident Indians.

Contact: +91 95384 16161, ryan@vazassociates.in. Office: Mangalmurti Apartments, L.T. Road, opposite Maxus Mall, Borivali West, Mumbai 400092 (meetings by appointment). Content on this site is general information in line with ICAI guidelines and is not professional advice.

## Chartered accountancy services

- [Income tax](https://vazassociates.in/services/income-tax/): PAN and TAN, returns for individuals, HUFs, firms, LLPs and companies, regime choice, capital gains, advance tax, TDS and TCS returns, notices, appeals, updated returns, under the Income-tax Act, 2025 from 1 April 2026
- [Income-tax Act, 2025](https://vazassociates.in/services/income-tax-act-2025/): tax year, old and new sections, transition
- [Old and new tax regimes, salary](https://vazassociates.in/services/old-new-tax-regime-salary/): slabs, rebate, deductions, retirement benefits
- [Capital gains](https://vazassociates.in/services/capital-gains/): rates, exemptions, property, shares, funds
- [TDS and TCS](https://vazassociates.in/services/tds-tcs/): rates, defaults, corrections
- [Returns and refunds](https://vazassociates.in/services/itr-returns-refunds/): forms, revised and updated returns, refunds
- [GST](https://vazassociates.in/services/gst/): registration, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, QRMP and composition, GSTR-9 and 9C, LUT and refunds, e-invoicing, notice replies
- [Audit and assurance](https://vazassociates.in/services/audit-assurance/): statutory audit, tax audit, internal audit, internal financial controls (IFC), information systems audit, stock and receivables audit, trust and NGO audit
- [Co-operative housing society accounting and audit](https://vazassociates.in/services/housing-society/): maintenance billing, annual accounts, audit under the Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act, 1960, rectification reports, GST and TDS for societies
- [NRI taxation](https://vazassociates.in/services/nri-taxation/): residential status and RNOR, NRE, NRO and RFC accounts, TDS on property sales, lower deduction certificates, DTAA relief, Form 15CA and 15CB
- [NRI tax questions](https://vazassociates.in/services/nri-tax-questions/): residential status, filing returns from abroad, property sale TDS, NRE, NRO and FCNR, DTAA, investments and income tax notices
- [Foreign companies in India](https://vazassociates.in/services/foreign-business/): choice of subsidiary, LLP, branch, liaison or project office, FEMA and RBI reporting (FC-GPR, FLA), corporate tax, payments to non-residents, transfer pricing, GST, accounts, payroll and group reporting
- [AIS and Form 26AS reconciliation](https://vazassociates.in/services/ais-26as-reconciliation/)
- [GST reconciliation and notices](https://vazassociates.in/services/gst-reconciliation/)
- [GST updates](https://vazassociates.in/services/gst-updates/): dated changes from October 2026 to January 2027: registration, rule 14B, REG-16, TDS on scrap, post-sale discounts, refunds, Circulars 257 to 266, e-way bill numbers
- [GST notices and replies](https://vazassociates.in/services/gst-notices/): ASMT-10, DRC-01A, DRC-01, DRC-01B, DRC-01C and DRC-07, time limits under sections 73, 74 and 74A, penalties and appeals
- [GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C for FY 2025-26](https://vazassociates.in/services/gstr-9-annual-return/): due date, turnover limits, ITC cut-off, late fee and pre-filing checks
- [Accounts writing and bookkeeping](https://vazassociates.in/services/accounts-bookkeeping/)
- [Fractional CFO advisory](https://vazassociates.in/services/fractional-cfo/)
- [Forensic audit](https://vazassociates.in/services/forensic-audit/)
- [Financial modelling](https://vazassociates.in/services/financial-modelling/)

## GST changes 2026-27
- [GST changes 2026-27 explained](https://vazassociates.in/faq/#g6): refunds, inverted duty refund on input services, GSTR-3B linked to GSTR-1, arrest and penalty changes, show-cause notice threshold, ARQP scheme, late fee waiver, e-commerce seller registration. Status dated and updated as notifications are issued.
